body:
Cocaine is no joke. When ur about to sniff that first line be prepared for whats ahead cuz ur life is goin to change forever.
When I think of the last 2 years, all I can remember is the endless nights with me a my friend p and my girlfriend z on coke. I remember stayin up for 3 days on coke n e, then on the third night almost have a panic attack after the first line of that day.
Porbably about the 7 or 8 time I sniffed cocaine the comedown was now present, and I noticed I would come down a lot harder then my friends, its worst feelin u can ever imagine. Just thinkin about makes me uneasy. After about a month doin it me n ps life revolved around cncaine, where we gettin money? Whos got the best shyt? Etc.
Dont get me wrong the first year on coke was had some amazin times, but what goes up eventually comes down. Then last winter p moved away n I kicked the habit for I think for 25 days, then soon I found a connection at work, who was spottin me it to sell. This is were things went wrong. I started sniffin coke everyday after work.
I started sniffin coke everyday after work.
Gettin no sleep n goin to work 9 hours in a factory. Soon co workers started to catch on because of how shity I looked. I started gettin mad shaky as soon as I do 1 line now,and after a day of sniffin I would have bad hallucantions. I forgot to metion coke has always made me paranoid. Not a lil paranoid either. I remeber getting a motel room with p and z n I would literly check the peephole every 30 seconds. I was also convinced people could hear me everytime I sniffed so my paranoia made me not sniff. So my nose started gettin so cut up it was constantly burnin n bleeding.soon I was labled the town coke head. Broke up with beautiful girlfriend n sat in my room everynight sniffin cocaine.
I stopped usin but I noticed that my body was still messed up, I was still shaking couldnt make sentences properly, and at this point started to notice I was constantly hallucanating n found out I had hppd. I also did quite a bit of e back then so I firgured it was from that.
Right now I'm 2 months clean n am now recoverin from the shaking and I dont fuck up my sentences. I'm dealing with hppd the best I can but sometimes I still get really depressed wonderin if I will ever see the sky with out seeing tons of little bubbles or looking at a blank wall without static and shadows moving all over it. Stay out of the struggle.
